question: Our RPC API lives at `/api/v1/rpc` instead of the root. How do I make generated libraries automatically prepend this path? Can developers change it at runtime to point at different environments?
ground_truth: To configure a custom base path for generated SDK clients, add the `x-fern-base-path` extension to the `info` section of your OpenRPC configuration file. For example, setting `x-fern-base-path: /api/v1/rpc` configures the SDK to automatically prepend `/api/v1/rpc` to all requests. This base path is set at SDK generation time as the default. However, most Fern-generated SDKs allow users to override the base URL or path during client initialization to support different environments (like staging vs production). SDK users can typically provide a full base URL when creating the client instance, which would include your custom path (e.g., `https://staging.api.com/api/v1/staging/rpc`), allowing them to point the SDK at different environments while still maintaining the generated default for the common case.
